pages.title: 识别 / 对比浮窗 v2
pages.note: 恢复按格数分组及顶部大金候选占比百分数；示例 50%（3/6 件），按全部候选计算。保留回放、逐卡试听、字号及单图钉；不分页。
pages.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup / precise-object-edit.
Edit target: image 1, previous Chinese game-audio recognition floating-window concept. Style reference: image 2, actual Arena Breakout inventory UI.
Primary request: Revise this floating overlay to RESTORE TWO EXISTING CORE FEATURES OMITTED FROM THE OLD CONCEPT: clearly labeled GROUPS BY INVENTORY CELL COUNT, and a prominently displayed OVERALL GOLD CANDIDATE PERCENTAGE. This is a focused iteration, preserve charcoal tactical game UI, rectangular thin gray borders, pale sage active states, crisp Chinese text, readable thumbnails, per-item sample playback, size controls, ONE bright/dim pin icon.
Composition: ONE finished desktop floating overlay, front-facing flat screenshot, 1792x1024 landscape or similar; window fills canvas with only 20px dark outer margin. Wide shallow compact arrangement. No browser, scene, sidebar, poster, exploded diagram, explanatory arrows, giant logo. No large unused areas.
Top compact titlebar (roughly 58px): small crate/wave icon, "行商听音助手"; subtle status dot "试听中 · 采音已暂停"; right "字号" square segmented "小" "中" "大" (中 selected); one pin and close.
Second compact result bar (~110px): at left small label "大金候选占比" above large restrained warm off-white/pale-gold number "50%" (most prominent numerical information, about 54px text). Alongside it show exactly "3 / 6 件候选为大金" and smaller "按全部候选计算". Right side "6 件候选" and smaller note "占比不代表真实出货概率". DO NOT replace percentage with only a fraction; show both. Use one faint horizontal 50%-filled indicator if helpful, no donuts or dashboard graphs.
Third short toolbar (~58px): rectangular direct buttons "▶ 回放当前声音", "■ 停止", "保存 WAV", "返回监听". One row, readable and moderately compact.
Candidate area (~400px) MUST HAVE THREE VISIBLY DISTINCT SIDE-BY-SIDE GROUP PANELS separated by 16px gutters, all equal height. Each group has a single clear bold header ABOVE both its two cards and a divider line. Exact group headers "2 格" with small "2 件", "4 格" with small "2 件", and "6 格" with small "2 件". These are persistent section headings, NOT filter tabs. All six items visible simultaneously, two cards per group in one horizontal row. Cell-count classification must be immediately obvious from the panel structure, never merely dimensions under individual cards.
Group 1 (2 格, 2 件): card 热成像模块, text 2×1, red item-name text / gold marker (isGold true); card 数据线, 2×1, white name (not gold).
Group 2 (4 格, 2 件): card 古董茶壶, 2×2, red name / gold marker (isGold true); card 密码机, 2×2, white name (not gold).
Group 3 (6 格, 2 件): card 金狮雕像, 3×2, red name / gold marker (isGold true); card 石膏像, 2×3, white name (not gold).
Total exactly 6 cards, exactly 3 gold = 50%. DO NOT repeat, omit or add any item. Dimensions must multiply to corresponding group. Gold lion and plaster bust both under 6 格 even though different orientations. Each card has dark thumbnail compartment, modest realistic game-inventory object illustration, name, dimension, tiny rarity dot and rectangular "▶ 听样本" button. Keep thumbnail art compact, not giant product photography. Gold lion resembles small lion statue, thermal module a small electronic optical module, data cable coiled cable, antique teapot a small Chinese teapot, cipher machine portable cryptographic electronics, plaster bust a white bust.
Footer thin and muted: unchecked square "展开相近音效" then "仅供对比，不计入候选占比"; far right "布局示例". No expanded near-sound results currently shown.
Colors and typography: near-black #101214, panels #1A1E20, controls #252B2F, one-pixel gray #3B4245 borders, off-white #E4E8E5, muted #969E9C, subtle sage #A8BDB1. Percentage may use restrained pale gold #F1C879 matching existing app; no bright green slab. Slight game texture only. Square corners max 2px. Good breathing room and hierarchy without oversizing controls.
Critical invariants: a visible overall "50%" plus "3 / 6"; three explicit cell-count group headers; correct total 6; no pagination or previous/next arrows; no per-item percentages or scores; one pin only; no "出货率50%" or fake calibrated probability; no random prices; no giant demo captions. Faithfully restore existing functionality while modernizing appearance.

Use case: ui-mockup. Deliver ONE polished, highly legible, implementable Chinese desktop UI screen, landscape 1536x1024. One application window straight on, no perspective or device, with no marketing text.
This is one screen in a coherent design set for 行商听音助手. Reference 1 supplies shared charcoal style only. Reference 2 supplies the desired comparison utility style; reference 3 is the actual game inventory.
Palette exactly near-black #101214, charcoal #1A1E20, dark slate controls #252B2F, thin gray borders #3B4245, off-white #E4E8E5, subdued gray #969E9C, sparse pale sage #A8BDB1 selected details. Squared 0-2px corners. No bright blue/green surfaces, no pill shapes, no gradients, no lights/glows, no modern rounded dashboard. Thin industrial separators and clear bold Chinese headings. Muted red and gold only signal collectible rarity. Original small crate/audio logo, no copied competitor name.
Global behavior: NO pagination or page-number arrows for lists. Long content scrolls only after available space is filled; candidate-heavy layouts widen into columns before growing taller. Font size and playback remain directly accessible in comparison view. NO invented per-item probabilities, accuracy, confidence scores, prices, login/cloud, or hidden controls. Example item/results are schematic data, label 设计示例 in a tiny unobtrusive corner. Precise Chinese labels specified, no irrelevant components.
SCREEN SPEC:
Standalone window header 音频文件识别结果, subtitle 离线文件 · 示例录音.wav. Display 示例结果, 4 件候选, 大金候选占比 3/4 · 75%, clear 非出货概率. A row of inventory-styled thumbnail cards 古董茶壶 / 宝石项链 / 卡莫纳之星 / 密码机 each 2×2, first three red collectible names. A small badge 稳定结果, no item probability or fabricated price. Footer 同音候选需要结合游戏实际物品判断。 No previous/next arrows, no pagination, no unrelated primary workflow controls. Dark charcoal shared design with readable precise item images. Tiny 设计示例.
